title.en: Record day-10 real-learning QA identity-recovery blocker
title.zh: 记录第 10 天真实学习 QA 身份恢复受阻

purpose.en: Publish an accurate bilingual administrator Project record for the August 30 real-user QA attempt without claiming signed-in learning evidence that Chrome and Gmail could not safely provide.
purpose.zh: 为 8 月 30 日真实用户 QA 尝试发布准确的双语管理员 Project 记录，不虚构 Chrome 与 Gmail 无法安全提供的登录学习证据。

en: Record the passed 4,320-row sentence catalog contract and the successful 32-route anonymous production preflight as prerequisite evidence only.
Record the exact non-secret identity-recovery blocker and mark the four-language signed-in acceptance matrix incomplete rather than passed.
Publish each language's deterministic plan, measured active-learning time, deep-focus skill, and missing score-log evidence.
zh: 记录已通过的 4,320 行句子目录契约与 32 条正式站匿名路由预检，并明确它们只属于前置证据。
记录准确且不含隐私的身份恢复阻塞，将四语登录验收矩阵标记为未完成而非通过。
发布每种语言的确定性计划、实测有效学习时间、深度重点技能及缺失的分数日志证据。

en: Administrator Project release report for Pacific date 2026-08-30; no Course, Play, Everyday Speaking, learner, score, credit, challenge, reward, leaderboard, payment, referral, or certificate data is changed.
zh: 太平洋日期 2026-08-30 的管理员 Project 发布报告；不更改课程、Play、生活口语、学习者、分数、积分、挑战、奖励、排行榜、支付、推荐或证书数据。

en: The production dashboard redirected to the Chinese sign-in page because no reusable dedicated learner session existed. Historical verification-message inspection identified the newest recipient as the permanent administrator, which was correctly rejected as a substitute for the dedicated learner.

Repeated Chrome control timeouts prevented safe inspection of an older matching Gmail verification message, so no test address or one-time code was submitted to SmartLingo and no signed-in learning action was started.

English: 5 minutes planned, 0 measured, Writing deep focus and SmartCard Practice feature focus; Course, Sprint, SmartCard, Challenge, Everyday Speaking, Rankings, Score History, displayed score, and persisted score log are incomplete.

Japanese: 2 minutes planned, 0 measured, Speaking deep focus and SmartCard Practice feature focus; Course, Sprint, SmartCard, Challenge, Everyday Speaking, Rankings, Score History, displayed score, and persisted score log are incomplete.

Spanish: 2 minutes planned, 0 measured, Listening deep focus and SmartCard Practice feature focus; Course, Sprint, SmartCard, Challenge, Everyday Speaking, Rankings, Score History, displayed score, and persisted score log are incomplete.

Italian: 5 minutes planned, 0 measured, Writing deep focus and Course feature focus; Course, Sprint, SmartCard, Challenge, Everyday Speaking, Rankings, Score History, displayed score, and persisted score log are incomplete.
zh: 正式站用户面板因没有可复用的专用学习者会话而跳转到中文登录页。检查历史验证码邮件时确认最新收件身份属于永久管理员，因此正确拒绝将其替代专用学习者。
Chrome 控制 Gmail 时反复超时，无法安全检查更早的匹配验证码邮件；因此没有向 SmartLingo 提交测试邮箱或一次性验证码，也没有开始任何登录学习操作。
英语：计划 5 分钟，实测 0 分钟，深度重点为写作，功能重点为 SmartCard 练习；课程、今日速成、SmartCard、挑战、生活口语、排行榜、分数历史、显示分数及持久化分数日志均未完成。
日语：计划 2 分钟，实测 0 分钟，深度重点为口语，功能重点为 SmartCard 练习；课程、今日速成、SmartCard、挑战、生活口语、排行榜、分数历史、显示分数及持久化分数日志均未完成。
西班牙语：计划 2 分钟，实测 0 分钟，深度重点为听力，功能重点为 SmartCard 练习；课程、今日速成、SmartCard、挑战、生活口语、排行榜、分数历史、显示分数及持久化分数日志均未完成。
意大利语：计划 5 分钟，实测 0 分钟，深度重点为写作，功能重点为课程；课程、今日速成、SmartCard、挑战、生活口语、排行榜、分数历史、显示分数及持久化分数日志均未完成。

en: The sentence exercise contract passed all five tests: 36 official courses, exactly 120 published sentences per course, and runtime-aligned Listening and Writing builders with ten unique daily items.
GitHub Actions route-preflight run 33305452201 completed successfully for 2026-08-30; its artifact passed all 32 anonymous production routes and was not treated as login or learning evidence.
The real Chrome production check visibly reached /zh/auth/login from /zh/dashboard. The required signed-in matrix did not run, and this report deliberately records a blocker rather than a pass.

Repeat-after-me remained off and no microphone permission was requested. No payment, referral, certificate, course-credit, challenge-reward, or leaderboard action was performed; administrator-level ledger equality was not available and is not claimed.
zh: 句子练习契约五项全部通过：36 门正式课程每门恰有 120 条已发布句子，Listening 与 Writing 运行时构建器一致且每天各有 10 道唯一题。
GitHub Actions 路由预检 33305452201 已为 2026-08-30 成功完成；工件中的 32 条正式站匿名路由全部通过，且未被当作登录或学习证据。
真实 Chrome 正式站检查从 /zh/dashboard 可见跳转到 /zh/auth/login。必需的登录验收矩阵没有执行，本报告明确记录受阻而非通过。
三次跟读保持关闭且没有请求麦克风权限。没有执行支付、推荐、证书、课程积分、挑战奖励或排行榜操作；管理员级账本一致性不可用，因此不声称已确认。

en: Retry the same 2026-08-30 deterministic plan only after Chrome can safely inspect the dedicated learner's newest matching Gmail verification message; then complete all four languages and publish measured signed-in evidence without rounding or synthetic activity.
zh: 仅在 Chrome 能安全检查专用学习者最新匹配的 Gmail 验证邮件后，才按同一份 2026-08-30 确定性计划重试；随后完成四语矩阵，并发布不取整、不含合成活动的实测登录证据。

en: Keep the learner identity anonymized, keep SmartLingo's Chinese interface and four target-language plan, and preserve every site-local Clerk, Gmail, D1, Cloudflare, payment, referral, certificate, and learning-data boundary.
zh: 保持学习者身份匿名，保留 SmartLingo 中文界面与四种目标语言计划，并继续隔离站点专属 Clerk、Gmail、D1、Cloudflare、支付、推荐、证书及学习数据边界。

rollback.en: No data migration is included; if the report presentation regresses, restore the prior Cloudflare Worker while retaining the non-secret QA evidence in source history.
rollback.zh: 本次不含数据迁移；若报告展示出现回归，可恢复上一版 Cloudflare Worker，并在源码历史中保留不含隐私的 QA 证据。
